title: ze_popkart
description:
ZE_POPKART_R
--------------------------------------------------------------
This map is a reset version of ze_popkart_b3.
It consists of 5 rounds in total: 
2 rounds of ZE, 2 rounds of racing, and 1 round of ZM.
Come and experience driving popkart in CS2.
Have fun! 
--------------------------------------------------------------
Mapper: 皮皮猫233, 佐贺
Post-processing: SIRIoin
Thanks: Fubuki,气流
Kart model provided by Slime 
--------------------------------------------------------------
This reset version is currently in the testing phase. 
Many bugs are waiting to be fixed. 
--------------------------------------------------------------
Now, we have the language switching function.
You can switch languages in the admin room.
